edits:
shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if test -n "$COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE"; then
            node scripts/ordinary-completed-stage-admission.mjs publish
          else
            node scripts/protected-private-production-runtime.mjs \
              --publish \
              --private-root "$RAVRADAR_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_ROOT" \
              --bundle "$RAVRADAR_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_BUNDLE" \
              --repository-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
              --expected .cache/private-production-runtime-expected.json \
              --source-head "$GITHUB_SHA"
          fi
        run: >-
          node scripts/protected-private-production-runtime.mjs
          --publish
          --private-root "$RAVRADAR_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_ROOT"
          --bundle "$RAVRADAR_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_BUNDLE"
          --repository-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          --expected .cache/private-production-runtime-expected.json
          --source-head "$GITHUB_SHA"
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if test -n "$COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE"; then
            node scripts/ordinary-completed-stage-admission.mjs before-publish
          else
            node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs before-publish
          fi
        run: node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs before-publish
          if test -n "$COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE"; then
            node scripts/ordinary-completed-stage-admission.mjs target
          else
            node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs target
          fi
          node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs target
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if test -n "$COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE"; then
            node scripts/ordinary-completed-stage-admission.mjs preserve-cipher
            echo ORIGINAL_CIPHERTEXT_PRESERVED_NOT_NEW_GENERATION
          else
            node scripts/staged-private-production-runtime.mjs seal \
              --repository-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
              --private-root "$RAVRADAR_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_ROOT" \
              --bundle "$RAVRADAR_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_BUNDLE" \
              --expected .cache/private-production-runtime-expected.json \
              --source-head "$GITHUB_SHA" \
              --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
              --run-attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
              --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ravradar-private-build-stage/sealed.bin"
          fi
        run: >-
          node scripts/staged-private-production-runtime.mjs seal
          --repository-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          --private-root "$RAVRADAR_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_ROOT"
          --bundle "$RAVRADAR_PRIVATE_RUNTIME_BUNDLE"
          --expected .cache/private-production-runtime-expected.json
          --source-head "$GITHUB_SHA"
          --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          --run-attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ravradar-private-build-stage/sealed.bin"
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          STAGED_PRIVATE_BUILD_MASTER_SECRET: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if test -n "$COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE"; then
            node scripts/ordinary-completed-stage-admission.mjs admit
          else
            node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs admit
          fi
        run: node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs admit
          CURRENT_FAMILY_COLD_START: ${{ inputs.current_family_cold_start }}
          if test -n "$COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE"; then
            node scripts/ordinary-completed-stage-admission.mjs request
          else
            node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs request
          fi
          node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs request
      - name: Verify the original ordinary-stage source before any hydration
        if: inputs.completed_stage_source != ''
        run: node scripts/ordinary-completed-stage-admission.mjs source
        env:
          CURRENT_FAMILY_COLD_START: ${{ inputs.current_family_cold_start }}
          EPOCH_BOOTSTRAP: ${{ inputs.weather_state_epoch_bootstrap }}
          EPOCH_REENTRY: ${{ inputs.weather_state_epoch_checkpoint_reentry }}
          NATIVE_IDENTITY_RECOVERY: ${{ inputs.native_sampling_identity_original_recovery }}
          EXTENDED_PROVIDER_BOOTSTRAP: ${{ inputs.extended_provider_bootstrap }}
          PRODUCE_HANDOFF: ${{ inputs.produce_weather_handoff }}

      COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.completed_stage_source }}
      CURRENT_FAMILY_COLD_START: ${{ inputs.current_family_cold_start }}
      EPOCH_BOOTSTRAP: ${{ inputs.weather_state_epoch_bootstrap }}
      EPOCH_REENTRY: ${{ inputs.weather_state_epoch_checkpoint_reentry }}
      NATIVE_IDENTITY_RECOVERY: ${{ inputs.native_sampling_identity_original_recovery }}
      EXTENDED_PROVIDER_BOOTSTRAP: ${{ inputs.extended_provider_bootstrap }}
      PRODUCE_HANDOFF: ${{ inputs.produce_weather_handoff }}
      completed_stage_source:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

checkpoint_only: ${{ inputs.checkpoint_target_hour != '' && inputs.completed_stage_source == '' }}
      checkpoint_only: ${{ inputs.checkpoint_target_hour != '' }}
      completed_stage_source: ${{ inputs.completed_stage_source }}
        if: inputs.checkpoint_target_hour != '' && inputs.completed_stage_source == ''
        if: inputs.checkpoint_target_hour != ''
          COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.completed_stage_source }}
          CURRENT_FAMILY_COLD_START: ${{ inputs.current_family_cold_start }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if test -n "$COMPLETED_STAGE_SOURCE"; then
            node scripts/ordinary-completed-stage-admission.mjs pin
          else
            node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs pin
          fi
        run: node scripts/completed-private-runtime-admission.mjs pin
      - name: Reject an orphaned completed-stage locator before target selection
        if: inputs.completed_stage_source != ''
        shell: bash
        env:
          COMPLETED: ${{ inputs.completed_private_runtime }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$COMPLETED" = true

      completed_stage_source:
        description: 'Optional exact ordinary completed-stage run-attempt-producerhead; requires completed reuse and its original checkpoint target hint'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
